about.title: About me
about.content: I'm Andi, a passionate developer based in Madagascar, driven by the desire to create fluid, accessible and elegant web experiences. My atypical background has taught me to combine technical rigor and attention to detail. What do I like best? Transforming an idea into a living interface that speaks to the user.
about.content2: Working with Andi means working with someone who is reliable, curious and always ready to take on a challenge. His attention to detail and ability to understand needs really make a difference.
about.names: Lead Developer at Société Malgache des Magasins
